name: frontend-default
description: LLMServingSim's own policies as of upstream a4053bc, named so a run states them: vLLM-V1-shaped continuous batching, whole-sequence admission, no prefill/decode split, KV reserved on admission (reserve_full_isl), preemption from the running set's tail, no prefetch, no network-aware scheduling.

reservation.notes: capacity reserved at admission for the whole sequence; G6 adds transfer-time and just-in-time
